fusions.name: Trampled Under
fusions.desc: A trampling blow that deals 32 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health. Its damage rises +5% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +30%).

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Wave
fusions.desc: Looses a wide cone of pounding force that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Barrelling Ahead
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 6 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Pounding Pace
fusions.desc: You move 12% faster, and your physical resistance rises by 8%.
